items.title: File Einspruch (tax objection)
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: The letter's own date is 19.11.2026 but it states it was actually posted on 20.11.2026 ('Abgesandt am 20.11.2026'); the later, stated posting day governs. Under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter sent by ordinary post since 2025 counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 20.11.2026 + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday, not a Sunday/holiday, so no shift). The one-month Einspruch period of §355 AO starts the next day (§108 Abs. 1 AO, §187 Abs. 1 BGB): 25.11.2026, and ends one month later on the day numerically corresponding to the start day (§188 Abs. 2 BGB): 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a statutory public holiday in Bremen (only 25. and 26.12. are holidays), so no further shift applies.

items.quote: Die verbleibende Zahlung von 1.624,00 € ist am 28.12.2026 fällig.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed due date of 28.12.2026 for the remaining payment of 1.624,00 €. 28.12.2026 is a Monday, which is neither a weekend day nor a public holiday in Bremen (Bremen's nearby holidays are 25.12. Friday and 26.12. Saturday), so the stated date applies without any shift.

warnings: The letter's printed date (19.11.2026) and its stated posting date (20.11.2026, 'Abgesandt am') differ; the later, stated posting date was used to compute the deemed-delivery and Einspruch deadline, as it is more specific and later.
The letter warns that late-payment surcharges ('Zuschläge') accrue for every month payment is overdue, so the 28.12.2026 due date should not be missed.
